name: Frontend Engineer
summary: Implements user-facing web interfaces with attention to accessibility, performance, and design fidelity.
whatTheyDo: Translate designs into responsive UI, manage client state, integrate APIs, and optimize rendering and UX quality.
typicalDailyWork: Collaborate with UI/UX on edge cases
Improve Core Web Vitals when measured
careerTransitions: Often move into fullstack or design-engineering hybrid roles
bangladeshNotes: Bangladesh openings frequently list React (sometimes Next.js) alongside TypeScript or JavaScript. Full-stack ads may still emphasize frontend skills heavily. Alternative titles such as React Developer and UI Developer are common on local boards. Exact frameworks differ by company—verify each listing rather than assuming React-only markets.
commonQualifications: Comfort with Git and code review
experienceExpectations: Junior roles may accept strong portfolios; mid/senior ads often cite multi-year React experience.
